title.value: S MALL -GAN: S PEEDING UP GAN T RAINING USING C ORE -S ETS
title.justification: The title precisely reflects the content and innovation presented in the paper, specifically focusing on speeding up GAN training using Core-Set techniques.
title.quote: S MALL -GAN: S PEEDING UP GAN T RAINING USING C ORE -S ETS

analysis.description: The paper introduces a method to accelerate the training of Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) by employing Core-set selection to simulate large batch training without the associated computational costs. This technique shows improved efficiency in GAN training and applicability to various GAN architectures, promoting faster and more memory-efficient training processes.

type.justification: The paper provides experimental results on several datasets demonstrating the effectiveness of the proposed method. It conducts experiments across different types of GANs and datasets, showcasing empirical improvements in speed and efficiency.
type.quote: We conduct experiments showing that this technique substantially reduces training time and memory usage for modern GAN variants...
